- Stand-ups: Morning in east wing, evening in library annex, afternoon in loading bay.
- Room Issues: Lifts slow near harbour, print room, loading bay, garden studio, east wing. Repainting in garden studio, harbour room, loading bay, library annex, print room, east wing. Umbrellas in harbour, loading bay, garden studio, east wing.
- Temperature: Bram, Ada, Wren, Ines, Rafe, Finn, Opal, Pia, Jonah, Esme cold. Dell/Nils think east wing too cold.
- Availability: Bram (garden studio morning), Nils (north office evening), Opal (east wing evening), Mira (loading bay morning), Leon (loading bay evening).
